quorum_summary.correction_note: Phase 21B.4.17.1 corrected three evidence/status inconsistencies: DeepSeek's automated-evaluation status (-> CLEAR), MiniMax M3's commercial-use classification (-> REVIEW_REQUIRED/UNQUALIFIED), and Mistral Large 3's teacher-use status (-> NOT_EVALUATED). Phase 21B.4.17.2 closes a further, DIFFERENT gap: the quorum semantics documented here now explicitly mean FULL GENESIS FRONTIER PROTOCOL EXECUTION QUORUM (which ultimately includes the sealed private holdout), not merely public/internal evaluation. DeepSeek's private-holdout compatibility, previously PERMITTED_IN_PRINCIPLE on the insufficient basis of 'nothing requires publication,' was re-evaluated against DeepSeek's actual Privacy Policy (which states Personal Data including User Input may be used to train DeepSeek's own models, with only an unexercised opt-out right and no confirmed Open-Platform-specific no-training carve-out) and corrected to REVIEW_REQUIRED. Because full-protocol quorum counting requires PERMITTED private-holdout compatibility, DeepSeek's access_preflight_status is corrected to UNQUALIFIED for full-protocol purposes -- it remains PUBLIC_EVAL_READY (a separate, informational, non-quorum-determining count) via public_eval_access_preflight_status=PREFLIGHT_READY_PENDING_FRESH_ZERO_CASH_CHECK.
quorum_summary.quorum_status_rationale: Per phase §15/§6, a reference counts toward the FULL-PROTOCOL execution quorum only when BOTH reference_evaluation_admission_status=ADMITTED AND access_preflight_status is QUALIFIED_FOR_FUTURE_EXECUTION or PREFLIGHT_READY_PENDING_FRESH_ZERO_CASH_CHECK -- and access_preflight_status here represents readiness to receive the sealed private holdout, not merely public evaluation. After the Phase 21B.4.17.2 correction, ZERO references satisfy this (0 references, 0 organizations) -- DeepSeek V4.1-Flash is the only reference that is PUBLIC_EVAL_READY, but its private-holdout compatibility remains REVIEW_REQUIRED, so it does not count toward full-protocol quorum. This is a smaller, but more honest, count than the prior (still-too-generous) 1-reference figure -- no reference was promoted or preserved merely to keep quorum higher.
